review.purpose: Retrieve a complete bounded attribute population to distinguish total footprint, land area and weighted water share.
review.finding: Fourteen unique Massachusetts counties materialized once with a direct pushed STATE predicate and attribute-only projection, no geometry/LIMIT. Exact snapshot fingerprint guards live experiment comparability. Unweighted29.7% versus area-weighted26.1% water share retained; exploratory threshold does not infer flood risk/population/usable land.

review.purpose: Check full feature retrieval against an independent exact remote count with explicit source filtering.
review.finding: Named where_clause limits server count to STATE25; exact BIGINT14 reconciles local row count and unique GEOIDs. Distinct request timing prevents claiming an atomic source snapshot. Nonempty actual population, not an empty diagnostic.

review.purpose: Reconcile explicit remote land/water sums with the downloaded county attributes before weighting.

review.purpose: Keep the requested-location denominator when a real imagery service omits sample rows.
